page.layout: One page of title text, centred, with a woodcut engraving in the middle. Printed lines run from the top of the title block down to the imprint at the foot. Mirrored show-through from the reverse side sits in the title block and is left out.
page.notes: The title block is set in large capitals; the imprint lines at the foot are small and partly faded. The woodcut engraving in the centre of the page is not transcribed. The lines marked illegible are too faint, or too mixed with the mirrored show-through, to read letter by letter. The last line of the imprint shows only part of the date, and the printed year is not certain. Show-through lines are left out.
